title: Querétaro municipal government investigates alleged breach and leaked information from several agencies
date_note: Date of the article reporting the municipality's investigation; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: municipal government of Querétaro as named by the source
summary: Quadratín Querétaro reports that the Querétaro municipal government opened an investigation into an alleged breach of its computer systems and the spread of information reportedly taken from several agencies, including the municipal public security secretariat. Protective measures were activated on institutional platforms. Mayor Felifer Macías asked people to avoid speculation until the investigation's results are known.
plain: Querétaro's city government is investigating an alleged breach of its systems and information reportedly taken from several agencies. The mayor asks people to wait for the investigation's results.
exec: A Mexican municipal government is investigating an alleged breach and leaked material; authenticity and origin have not been established.

validation.note: One publisher (Quadratín Querétaro) relaying the municipal government's statement; no municipal page was read.
